newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end flat, 97 budget, policy are key.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end flat, 97 budget, policy are key.

text.p: Greek equities closed flat and brokers said Prime Minister Costas Simitis's major policy speech on Thursday and the 1997 budget in November would be the key to the future behaviour of the bourse.

"We are cautiously optimistic about the bourse," said Lambros Papakonstandinou, managing director of P&K Securities told Reuters. "The new policy statements and the 1997 budget are key to fresh cash injections."
Simitis, elected this month to a four-year term, will make a speech on his socialist government's economic policy on October 10 in parliament.
The Athens general share index closed 0.07 percent, or 0.70 points higher at 963.47 from Friday's 962.77 close after opening at 964.91 points.
Turnover was lower at 6.31 billion drachmas on volume of 3.94 million shares.
